item.text: The workspace is empty, so I’m creating a self-contained HTML/CSS/JavaScript app. It will keep course selection and registration in browser storage, with working search, filters, navigation, and a confirmation dialog.

Created the responsive course registration app in [index.html](/work/index.html), [styles.css](/work/styles.css), and [app.js](/work/app.js).

It includes the home, catalog, registration, and profile pages; course search and filters; add/remove course controls; a registration form with a confirmation modal; and a registered-course table. Course selections and student details persist in browser storage.

I didn’t run tests or a browser check.
